description: This file contains functions for batch processing and concurrent execution of language model completions, including handling multiple models and deployments, with support for specific providers like vllm.

methods.name: batch_completion
methods.description: Performs batch completion requests for a specified model, supporting both VLLM and other models with parallel execution.

methods.name: batch_completion_models
methods.description: Sends concurrent requests to multiple models and returns the first response received.

methods.name: batch_completion_models_all_responses
methods.description: Sends concurrent requests to multiple models and returns all responses from models that respond.
